sentences.text: Mr. Kishore Shrivastava, learned Senior coun  Shashank Verma, counsel for the applicant.

Mr. S.K.Shrivastava, learned GA for the resp Call for the record of the learned courts below.
Heard on I.A.No. 6015/2021, which is an application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the applicant.

This revision has been preferred by the petitioner against the order of appellate court which has sustained the conviction imposed upon him under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced him to suffer R.I. of 1 year and fine of Rs.2000/-, in default of payment of fine, 3 months additional R.I.
An application has been filed for exempting the surrender of the petitioner before this petition is heard.
Arising from the same conviction, the suspension was granted to another co-accused in lieu of his advanced age and illness, for which supporting documents were filed.
In that application also, this court has exercised its powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C, in allowing the said application.
In this case also, the petitioner is about 68 years of age and falls under the high risk category of being infected with corona virus, if he is sent to prison, which is a crowded place.
Under the circumstances, I deem it fit to exercise my powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C and exempt the petitioner from surrendering and going to prison.

Looking at the facts and circumstances of the case, I.A.No. 6015/2021 is allowed and it is directed that the appellant shall be enlarged on bail upon 2 CRR-1159-2021 his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.

The jail authorities shall have the appellant checked by the jail doctor to ensure that he is not suffering from the corona virus and if he is, he shall be sent to the nearest hospital designated by the S.K. 1 State for treatment.
